forum.flag_reason: Salvage found a broken link in this post

status.title: Link health
status.scheduler_missing: Salvage works in the background, through Flarum's scheduler, and the scheduler has not run yet. Add the cron line from Flarum's documentation, or nothing will be checked or mirrored.
status.scheduler_stale: Flarum's scheduler last ran {ago}. Salvage only works while it runs every minute.
status.scheduler_docs: How to set up the scheduler
status.scan_help: New and edited posts are tracked as they are saved. Scan the rest once, after installing; it runs in the background, 500 posts at a time.

links.more_posts: {count, plural, one {and # more post} other {and # more posts}}
links.fail_count: {count, plural, one {# failed check} other {# failed checks}}

actions.unlink_confirm: Remove this link from every post that holds it? The link text stays; the link itself cannot be put back except by editing the posts.

replace_modal.title: Replace link
replace_modal.help: Every post that links here will point to the new address instead. The text people see in the post does not change.
replace_modal.label: New address

errors.not_image: Not an image Salvage can mirror

settings.check_links_help: Find links in posts that no longer work. Each link is checked politely, a few at a time, and only called broken after failing on different days.
settings.mirror_images_help: Keep a copy of every image posted from another site, so posts keep their pictures when the other site removes them. Copies are re-encoded and stripped of metadata.
settings.use_fof_upload_help: When FoF Upload is on and the poster may upload, copies are stored wherever FoF Upload keeps files and appear in the poster's media manager. Otherwise they go to assets/salvage.
settings.archive_help: When a link breaks, ask the Wayback Machine whether it kept a copy, so you can point the link there with one click.
settings.auto_archive_help: Point broken links at their archive.org copy as soon as one is found, without waiting for staff. You can undo it per link.
settings.flag_posts_help: Put posts with newly broken links in the moderators' flag queue (needs Flags). At most 100 posts are flagged per round.
settings.per_run_help: A round runs every five minutes. Never more than 3 requests to one site per round.
settings.daily_mb_label: Mirror at most this much a day (MB)
settings.daily_mb_help: Anyone who can post can make the forum copy pictures, so a day's copies are capped. Images past the cap wait for the next day.
settings.skip_domains_help: One site per line, e.g. example.com (includes its subdomains). Use it for sites that block checkers or that you trust to stay up.

errors.unknown_action: That is not something Salvage can do with a link.
errors.still_applying: Salvage is still updating posts for this link. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.bad_url: Enter a full web address starting with https:// or http://, different from the broken one.
errors.no_archive: No archive.org copy was found for this link.
errors.undo_first: Undo the current decision for this link first.
errors.cannot_restore: Removed links cannot be put back automatically.
